notes: Profile: mid-market e-commerce platform focused on post-purchase UX (returns + shipping). Heavy seasonal spikes (Black Friday/Cyber week -> returns peak).
Primary ask: user-facing chat agent for returns that calls internal tools (order API, warehouse lookup). Needs streaming replies + function/tool calling for actions.
Latency SLO: target p95 <= 350ms for interactive streaming responses during normal traffic; acceptable up to 500ms during extreme peaks but want graceful degradation (partial replies + fallback).
Throughput: typical concurrent chats ~120, expected peak concurrency ~600 during peak season (5x). Concerned about cold-starts and startup KV cache warmup.
Security: requires SSO/SAML for admin console, KMS integration for customer data, audit logs for function calls; data residency preference for NA.

Current plan: finish hosted API POC, then evaluate Dedicated reserved pool to guarantee p95 at peak. Key decision factors: cost of reserved capacity vs. ability to auto-burst, SLA, and observability (per-route latency breakdown).
Quote from CPO: 'We can tolerate small quality regressions if it means sub-300ms feels instant to customers.'
SE notes: trying prefix caching + continuous batching reduced median by ~30ms; KV cache warmup strategy recommended prior to sales peaks.
